issue_request: FHIR-13173 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction raised against DSTU2 and applied for STU3. It requested changing ele-1 from relying only on `children().count() > id.count()` to explicitly allowing `hasValue()` so primitive values satisfy the invariant regardless of whether children() includes value.
initial_application: Jira records an SVN application comment. In nearby imported git history, commit 1040ceaadd7415c013f59cebd966098ff9dbda77 changed the old `source/datatypes/element.sheet.txt` expression from `children().count() > id.count()` to `hasValue() | (children().count() > id.count())`; the old sheet text was later removed as the authoritative source moved to `source/datatypes/element.xml`.
additional_context: FHIR-15911 later corrected the FHIRPath operator from collection union `|` to boolean `or`, FHIR-26565 later added the empty Parameters exception, and FHIR-43103 later clarified the human wording to mention value and children or both. Those related issues are already represented on the combined branch and explain why the current ele-1 text is broader than the seed's original wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. `source/fhir.ini` actively maps `element=types`, and the current `source/datatypes/element.xml` ele-1 expression is `hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count()) or $this is Parameters`, so no current source edit is needed for FHIR-13173.
